lines.text: Jethro, the priest of Midian, hears what God did for Israel and takes in Moses' wife Zipporah and her two sons.
Jethro comes to Moses at the mountain of God, and Moses bows down and kisses him.
Jethro says the LORD is greater than all other gods and brings a peace offering to God.
Jethro tells Moses to choose God-fearing, trustworthy men who hate dishonest gain, to judge minor cases and bring major issues to Moses.
Moses chooses capable men from all Israel as leaders of thousands, hundreds, twenties, and tens, then sends Jethro on his way.
